desync.description: Caught a synchronization inconsistency. Triggers a suicide from the node detecting it.

duplicate_ip.description: Another node of the cluster has the same IP address as the one joining it. The joining node does not start.
duplicate_ip.message: Another node shares the same IP address as this one (%s): %s.

full_state_unavailable.description: None of the cluster nodes discovered could give the joining node the cluster state, twice in a row (network split). The joining node does not start.
full_state_unavailable.message: Could not connect to the discovered cluster nodes (network split detected).

timeout.description: The node did not join the cluster within the configured cluster.joinTimeout. It does not start.
timeout.message: Failed to join the cluster: timed out (joinTimeout: %sms).
